name: structural-build-staging-copy-dir-reconciliation
body: `solution.component.structural-build-staging` is implemented-by `rust.build_script_build.main` and `rust.build_script_build.build_frontends`. `rust.build_script_build.copy_dir` is a recursive directory copier that stages the Java class directory (`build.rs:425`) and the TypeScript `node_modules` (`build.rs:337`), while the bundled structural scanner is a single binary (`structfrontend`) and every single-binary frontend stages with `std::fs::copy` in `build.rs::main` — `cppfrontend` (:172), `gofrontend` (:210), `rustfrontend` (:245), `mdfrontend` (:270-274), `pyfrontend` (:300-304), the TS `scanner.mjs` (:380), and `csharpfrontend` (:480).
